title: GateResult
description: One stored judgment of one object of one episode under one gate of the eval buckets (HAR-97): Bucket 1 B1 to B9, Bucket 2 D1 to D10, Bucket 3 S1 to S5. One shape and one store for every bucket, keyed by episode and gate. It says what was asked, what was observed, the verdict, why, the evidence it rests on, what the gate protects and which grader produced it. Rule R1: a pass, warn or fail needs at least one evidence ref that resolves to a stored object; with none the verdict is unknown. unknown is a legitimate verdict and is never styled as a pass; the older spelling abstain is read as unknown. Calibration is deferred: calibrated is always false and surfaces say not yet calibrated.

gate.description: The gate: B1-B9, D1-D10 or S1-S5.

sub_gate.description: The assertion under the gate (empty when the gate has one result per object).

label.description: A categorical result where a category is clearer than pass/fail (AGREE, COVERED, ...); empty when none.

span_id.description: The trace span the result attaches to (kind:ref, as in episode_trace.v1.json).

evidence_refs.description: kind:id refs that resolve to stored rows, for example candidate:UUID, activity:UUID, effect:KEY, gate_result:UUID. Empty only when the verdict is unknown.

allOf.description: Rule R1: no evidence, no verdict other than unknown.
